paragraph: [Maka Angola says Law No. 6/26 took effect on 4 August 2026](<https://www.makaangola.org/2026/08/angolas-fake-news-law-reveals-a-fear-of-the-truth/>). [It targets fake accounts, bots, deepfakes and coordinated campaigns, with removal orders and reporting duties for platforms](<https://www.makaangola.org/2026/08/angolas-fake-news-law-reveals-a-fear-of-the-truth/>). [CAZOS says the Agência de Protecção de Dados (APD), created by Presidential Decree 214/16, supervises and has sanctioning powers](<https://revista.cazosadvogados.com/pt/governacao-digital-ia>). [In June 2026 CAZOS said the APD's draft revision of Lei 22/11 has an AI chapter banning algorithmic social scoring](<https://revista.cazosadvogados.com/pt/governacao-digital-ia>). The draft is not in force, and the law dates from the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 gives an enforcement or redress decision about a harm from AI. Mature would need a dated enforcement, audit, takedown, penalty or redress decision about a harm from AI to be on record.

[Burundi's personal data protection law of 10 March 2026 requires notice where personal data are processed with AI for automated decision-making](<https://www.levellers.ai/what-is/ai-regulation-burundi>). [It also requires a fresh human decision for automated decisions with important effects, per Levellers](<https://www.levellers.ai/what-is/ai-regulation-burundi>). The law dates from the last twelve months. [The strategy was validated on 21-22 April 2026 with UNDP](<https://www.digitalbusiness.africa/burundi-la-strategie-nationale-de-lintelligence-artificielle-validee-axes-et-objectifs/>), and its governance axis provides for a National AI Commission. No source found names a body designated by law or decree with a mandate over AI harms. The data protection agency the 2026 law creates awaits its decree. Operating would need a body designated by law or decree with a mandate over AI harms or AI systems.

[In December 2025 the media regulator HAC barred uncontrolled use of AI in campaign coverage](<https://www.banouto.bj/politique/article/20251216-campagne-mediatique-pour-les-legislatives-et-communales-2026-au-benin-integralite-de-la-decision-de-la-haac>). [Article 576 of the Code du numérique punishes publishing a montage of a person's image or words without consent](<https://www.lanation.bj/numerique/images-retouchees-par-lintelligence-artificielle-les-limites-a-ne-pas-franchir>), with a penalty of up to five years and a FCFA 25 million fine. In the last twelve months, [in June 2026 several people were arrested for using AI tools to fake images](<https://www.les4verites.bj/plusieurs-arrestations-apres-lusage-malveillant-de-lia/>). No court decision in those arrests has been found. No source found says a body is designated by law or decree with a mandate over AI. Operating would need a body designated by law or decree with a mandate over AI harms or AI systems.

[A GRAIN comparative study of August 2026 looked at the data protection laws of four West African countries](<https://grain-africa.org/en/intelligence-artificielle-en-afrique-de-louest-grain-presente-les-resultats-dune-etude-comparative-pour-une-gouvernance-plus-inclusive-et-responsable-de-lia/>). [It found that Burkina Faso's personal data protection law alone explicitly refers to processing based on artificial intelligence](<https://grain-africa.org/en/intelligence-artificielle-en-afrique-de-louest-grain-presente-les-resultats-dune-etude-comparative-pour-une-gouvernance-plus-inclusive-et-responsable-de-lia/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says a body is designated with a mandate over AI, or gives an enforcement or redress decision about a harm from AI. Operating would need a body designated by law or decree with a mandate over AI harms or AI systems.

[In October 2026 the digital expert Hervé Tiwa said Cameroon has a legal gap on malicious use of AI](<https://www.digitalbusiness.africa/dr-herve-tiwa-il-y-a-un-vide-juridique-actuellement-quil-faut-combler/>). [He named deepfakes and disinformation, and said the cybercrime law must be extended to cover them](<https://www.digitalbusiness.africa/dr-herve-tiwa-il-y-a-un-vide-juridique-actuellement-quil-faut-combler/>). [In May 2026 the Gefona Digital Foundation said Cameroon's mechanisms are not specific to AI](<https://www.gefona.org/articles/protecting-electoral-integrity-against-ai-driven-disinformation>). Both statements are within the last twelve months. No source found reports a bill or draft guideline on AI harms, a rule in force or a designated authority. Preparing would need a bill, draft regulation or draft guideline addressing a harm from AI, or a draft that provides for an authority over AI.

[Comoros adopted a new Code de l'information et de la communication, Loi N°25-021/AU, on 26 December 2025](<https://www.cnpa-comores.org/un-nouveau-souffle-pour-le-cnpa/>). [Décret N°26-023/PR promulgated it on 2 February 2026, according to the press and audiovisual council, the CNPA](<https://www.cnpa-comores.org/un-nouveau-souffle-pour-le-cnpa/>). [Its Article 231 requires explicit labelling of any content generated or heavily modified by artificial intelligence](<https://www.cnpa-comores.org/un-nouveau-souffle-pour-le-cnpa/>). Both dates are within the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says a body is designated with a mandate over AI, or gives an enforcement or redress decision about a harm from AI. Operating would need a body designated by law or decree with a mandate over AI harms or AI systems.

In October 2025 [Cabo Verde's data protection commission CNPD set out the data protection rules that bear on AI](<https://www.cnpd.cv/cnpd-participa-na-workshop-e-na-reuniao-de-stakeholders-da-inteligencia-artificial-ia-na-africa-sobre-governanca-inovadora-e-capacitacao/>). [It then recognised the need to give the country a law to regulate artificial intelligence](<https://www.cnpd.cv/cnpd-participa-na-workshop-e-na-reuniao-de-stakeholders-da-inteligencia-artificial-ia-na-africa-sobre-governanca-inovadora-e-capacitacao/>). [In October 2024 the president of the National Elections Commission said Cabo Verde has no legal framework against AI-driven election disinformation](<https://www.balai.cv/noticias/cne-aponta-esforco-colaborativo-conjunto-de-varias-instituicoes-como-estrategia-para-garantir-integridade-do-sistema-eleitoral/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No bill or draft guideline on AI harms, no rule in force and no designated authority has been found. Preparing would need a bill, draft regulation or draft guideline addressing a harm from AI, or a draft that provides for an authority over AI.

For Djibouti, [in September 2026 a UNESCO-supported diagnostic found no law dedicated to AI beyond the Code du numerique](<https://www.wearetech.africa/fr/fils/actualites/tech/djibouti-se-dote-d-une-strategie-d-ia-sur-fond-de-preparation-encore-limitee>). [Dr Houssein Ahmed Assoweh, author of the UNESCO readiness report, says Djibouti has no legal framework designed for AI systems](<https://www.adi.dj/article/138857>). [A framework law and an AI authority are only recommended](<https://www.adi.dj/article/138857>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No bill or draft guideline on AI harms has been found, and no designated authority. Preparing would need a bill, draft regulation or draft guideline addressing a harm from AI, or a draft that provides for an authority over AI.

[On 23 October 2025 the Higher Education Minister, Kamal Badari, said the government is preparing a comprehensive legal text on AI](<https://www.echoroukonline.com/%D8%AA%D8%B4%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%B9%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%AC%D8%AF%D9%8A%D8%AF%D8%A9-%D9%84%D8%B6%D8%A8%D8%B7-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%B3%D8%AA%D8%AE%D8%AF%D8%A7%D9%85-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D8%AE%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%82>). [He said it would govern the ethical use of AI across all sectors and strengthen the regulatory authority](<https://www.echoroukonline.com/%D8%AA%D8%B4%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%B9%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%AC%D8%AF%D9%8A%D8%AF%D8%A9-%D9%84%D8%B6%D8%A8%D8%B7-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%B3%D8%AA%D8%AE%D8%AF%D8%A7%D9%85-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D8%AE%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%82>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says a rule on AI harms is in force, or that a body is designated with a mandate over AI. Establishing would need a law, decree, regulation or binding directive in force that addresses a harm from AI.

[Prime Ministerial Decree No. 207 of 2026 establishes the National Council for Artificial Intelligence, Quantum Computing and Emerging Technologies](<https://www.elwatannews.com/news/details/8210438>). [It was published in the Official Gazette on 18 January 2026](<https://www.elwatannews.com/news/details/8210438>). [The council sits under the Prime Minister and is chaired by the ICT minister](<https://www.elwatannews.com/news/details/8210438>). The decree dates from the last twelve months. The data protection law's executive regulations of November 2025 carry [Article 4(7), which binds processors that train AI on personal data to avoid harm to the people concerned](<https://masaar.net/ar/testing-the-executive-regulations-data-protection-law/>). No source found since October 2023 gives an enforcement or redress decision about a harm from AI. Mature would need a dated enforcement, audit, takedown, penalty or redress decision about a harm from AI to be on record.

[Levellers stated in June 2026 that Eritrea has no dedicated AI law and no AI oversight body](<https://www.levellers.ai/what-is/ai-regulation-eritrea>). [It found no statutory right not to be subject to automated decision-making](<https://www.levellers.ai/what-is/ai-regulation-eritrea>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No bill or draft guideline on AI harms, and no designated authority, has been found. Preparing would need a bill, draft regulation or draft guideline addressing a harm from AI, or a draft that provides for an authority over AI.

In May 2026 [Kinfe Yilma's KAS policy brief says the Ethiopian Artificial Intelligence Institute (EAII) has begun drafting AI legislation](<https://www.kas.de/documents/13332971/46464125/Policy+Brief+-+Digital+Version.pdf/fb1ec2aa-7d1f-ae0c-2d75-9843ff545476?t=1781127952232&version=1.0>). [The draft shows clear influence of the EU AI Act, and the Institute is still finalising it as a bill](<https://www.kas.de/documents/13332971/46464125/Policy+Brief+-+Digital+Version.pdf/fb1ec2aa-7d1f-ae0c-2d75-9843ff545476?t=1781127952232&version=1.0>). [In June 2026 The Conversation's authors said Ethiopia has tabled a draft AI law that adopts the European Union's risk-based approach](<https://theconversation.com/ai-regulation-in-africa-why-copying-the-european-model-wont-work-283524>). Both dates are within the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says a rule on AI harms is in force, or that a body is designated with a mandate over AI. Establishing would need a law, decree, regulation or binding directive in force that addresses a harm from AI.

[On 5 October 2026 decree 0436/PR promulgated the law ratifying the social-network ordinance, Gabon Media Time reports](<https://gabonmediatime.com/gabon-amendes-jusqua-50-millions-et-peines-de-prison-pour-les-abus-commis-sur-les-reseaux-sociaux/>). [Village de la Justice says ordinance n°0013/PR/2026 gives the Haute Autorité de la Communication (HAC) express competence to regulate digital platforms](<https://www.village-justice.com/articles/gabon-dote-droit-des-reseaux-sociaux-analyse-des-ordonnances-fevrier-2026,57009.html>). [The HAC is also given the task of auditing AI systems](<https://www.village-justice.com/articles/gabon-dote-droit-des-reseaux-sociaux-analyse-des-ordonnances-fevrier-2026,57009.html>). The promulgation is within the last twelve months. [In November 2025 a man was remanded in custody in Libreville for sharing an AI-made video of the president resigning](<https://gabonmediatime.com/gabon-en-prison-pour-avoir-partage-la-video-ia-de-demission-doligui-nguema/>). No source found gives an enforcement or redress decision under the rules on AI content. Mature would need a dated enforcement, audit, takedown, penalty or redress decision about a harm from AI to be on record.

In June 2026, [MyJoyOnline says Ghana's Cybersecurity Act, 2020 (Act 1038) can be applied to AI-assisted crimes](<https://www.myjoyonline.com/when-ai-lies-the-rising-danger-of-deepfakes-ai-cloning/>). [These include voice cloning and manipulated videos used in scams, though the Act does not regulate AI itself](<https://www.myjoyonline.com/when-ai-lies-the-rising-danger-of-deepfakes-ai-cloning/>). [On 30 March 2026 the police said making or sharing deepfakes of public figures is a crime](<https://www.graphic.com.gh/news/general-news/sharing-deepfake-content-online-is-a-criminal-offence-police-warn.html>). In the last twelve months, [on 28 March 2026 police arrested two suspects over deepfake videos of President Mahama and the First Lady](<https://www.graphic.com.gh/news/general-news/sharing-deepfake-content-online-is-a-criminal-offence-police-warn.html>). No court decision in the case has been found. No source found since October 2023 says a body is designated with a mandate over AI. Operating would need a body designated by law or decree with a mandate over AI harms or AI systems.

[On 25 April 2026 the Haute Autorité de la Communication issued decision N°016/HAC/P/2026, effective immediately](<https://topafrica.org/elections-2026-en-guinee-la-hac-encadre-la-couverture-mediatique-des-medias-prives/>). [Its article 17 forbids AI-manipulated deceptive content and deepfakes in private media coverage of the 31 May 2026 elections](<https://topafrica.org/elections-2026-en-guinee-la-hac-encadre-la-couverture-mediatique-des-medias-prives/>). [Sanctions go up to suspension from the campaign](<https://topafrica.org/elections-2026-en-guinee-la-hac-encadre-la-couverture-mediatique-des-medias-prives/>). [On 6 November 2026 the HAC signed decision N° 046/HAC/P/2026 restricting AI use in coverage of the November and December elections](<https://apva.africa/guinea-introduces-restrictions-on-ai-use-in-election-media-coverage/>). Both decisions are within the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says a body is designated with a mandate over AI, or gives an enforcement or redress decision about a harm from AI. Operating would need a body designated by law or decree with a mandate over AI harms or AI systems.

[In August 2025 the Ministry of Transport, Telecommunications and AI Systems was drafting an AI law, an anteproyecto](<https://realequatorialguinea.com/tecnologia/guinea-ecuatorial-da-los-primeros-pasos-para-disponer-de-una-ley-de-inteligencia-artificial/>). [The draft would make ANIAD, the national AI and data authority, an autonomous state body supervised by the ministry](<https://realequatorialguinea.com/tecnologia/guinea-ecuatorial-da-los-primeros-pasos-para-disponer-de-una-ley-de-inteligencia-artificial/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says a rule on AI harms is in force, or that a body is designated with a mandate over AI. Establishing would need a law, decree, regulation or binding directive in force that addresses a harm from AI.

[The draft national AI strategy says the Data Protection Act of 2019 regulates automated decision-making](<https://ict.go.ke/sites/default/files/2025-01/Kenya%20National%20AI%20Strategy%20%28Draft%29%20for%20Public%20Validation%20%20%5B14-01-2025%5D.pdf>). The same strategy says Kenya has no specific AI law. [CIPIT wrote in September 2026 that Kenya is drafting an AI Bill, 2026](<https://cipit.strathmore.edu/artificial-intelligence-in-east-africas-public-sector-ai-adoption-and-regulatory-preparedness-within-east-africa/>). In the last twelve months, in October 2026, [the Senate ICT Committee recommended that the Senate not proceed with the bill](<https://www.the-star.co.ke/news/2026-10-15-senate-committee-shoots-down-nyamus-bill-on-ai>). [The AI Commissioner's office](<https://www.the-star.co.ke/news/2026-10-15-senate-committee-shoots-down-nyamus-bill-on-ai>) exists only in that bill. No body is designated by law or decree with a mandate over AI harms, and no enforcement decision on an AI harm has been found. Operating would need a body designated by law or decree with a mandate over AI harms or AI systems.

[In March 2026 Oracle News Daily reported a memorandum by Abdullah Kamara](<https://oraclenewsdaily.com/2026/03/29/liberia-tech-expert-issues-early-warning-as-ai-threatens-liberias-job-market-security/>). [It says Liberia lacks clear guardrails on how AI should be used or governed](<https://oraclenewsdaily.com/2026/03/29/liberia-tech-expert-issues-early-warning-as-ai-threatens-liberias-job-market-security/>). [It says the Ministry of Post and Telecommunications, the Liberia Telecommunications Authority and the National Security Agency have no AI-specific frameworks yet](<https://oraclenewsdaily.com/2026/03/29/liberia-tech-expert-issues-early-warning-as-ai-threatens-liberias-job-market-security/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No bill or draft guideline on AI harms, no rule in force and no designated authority has been found. Preparing would need a bill, draft regulation or draft guideline addressing a harm from AI, or a draft that provides for an authority over AI.

[SMEX reports that Libya adopted a National Charter for AI Ethics on 1 June 2026](<https://smex.org/libyas-new-ai-strategy-celebrates-participation-yet-was-built-without-it/>). [The charter proposes a national oversight body, to be created by the Council of Ministers, to approve high-risk systems](<https://smex.org/libyas-new-ai-strategy-celebrates-participation-yet-was-built-without-it/>). In October 2026 [the National Council for Public Freedoms and Human Rights said its draft personal data protection law has a chapter on AI](<https://lana.gov.ly/post.php?id=368592&lang=ar>). Both dates are within the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says a rule on AI harms is in force, or that a body is designated with a mandate over AI. Establishing would need a law, decree, regulation or binding directive in force that addresses a harm from AI, such as deepfakes, automated decisions or AI in elections.

[In August 2025 the Government of Lesotho warned the public about AI-generated deepfake videos of the King and the Prime Minister](<https://digitalrightsalliance.africa/lesotho-government-warns-public-on-deep-fakes-amid-lack-of-cyber-law/>). [Its press statement said Lesotho lacks a dedicated cyber law to address them](<https://digitalrightsalliance.africa/lesotho-government-warns-public-on-deep-fakes-amid-lack-of-cyber-law/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No bill or draft guideline on AI harms, no rule in force and no designated authority has been found. Preparing would need a bill, draft regulation or draft guideline addressing a harm from AI, or a draft that provides for an authority over AI.

[HACA decision 50-26 of 16 June 2026 bars radio and television from broadcasting misleading AI-made election content](<https://www.theleveragedyears.com/ai-regulation-news/morocco-haca-decision-50-26-electoral-ai-content-2026>). [The CNDP says Law 09-08 governs AI processing of personal data](<https://www.cndp.ma/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/CNDP-Communique-IA-et-protection-des-donnees-a-caractere-personnel-FR.pdf>). EuroMedAI says that [on 16 January 2026 Organic Law 53.25 named AI tools among the means of electoral offences](<https://euromedai.org/en/ai-morocco-2026-elections-legal-framework/>). [It says the CNDP issued guidance in late August 2026 asking that AI-produced content be identified](<https://euromedai.org/en/ai-morocco-2026-elections-legal-framework/>). These dates are within the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 gives an enforcement or redress decision about a harm from AI. Mature would need a dated enforcement, audit, takedown, penalty or redress decision about a harm from AI to be on record.

[In September 2026 Tech-Connect reported that cybercrime bill 042/2026 doubles penalties for online fraud aided by AI](<https://www.tech-connect.info/madagascar-loi-cybercriminalite-vote-reporte/>). [Parliament postponed its examination indefinitely on 5 September 2026](<https://www.tech-connect.info/madagascar-loi-cybercriminalite-vote-reporte/>). That postponement is within the last twelve months. No rule on AI harms in force has been found, and no body designated over AI. Establishing would need a law, decree, regulation or binding directive in force that addresses a harm from AI, such as deepfakes, automated decisions or AI in elections.

[La Voix de Mopti reports that Mali's 2024 Penal Code includes cybercrime provisions but does not specifically recognise deepfakes or digital sextortion](<https://voixdemopti.com/deepfakes-et-chantage-sexuel-le-nouveau-visage-des-violences-numeriques/>). [It says this leaves a legal vacuum that makes convictions difficult](<https://voixdemopti.com/deepfakes-et-chantage-sexuel-le-nouveau-visage-des-violences-numeriques/>). [In October 2026 Tidiani Togola, founder of Tuwindi, said Mali's 2019 cybercrime text does not cover deepfakes](<https://amap.ml/2026/10/23/intelligence-artificielle-et-souverainete-numerique-le-mali-face-aux-defis-de-la-gouvernance-et-de-la-desinformation/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No bill or draft guideline on AI harms, and no designated authority, has been found. Preparing would need a bill, draft regulation or draft guideline addressing a harm from AI, or a draft that provides for an authority over AI.

[In January 2026 a law journal article by Bitone Viage said Mozambique has no specific legal provisions on AI-enabled digital crime](<https://www.revistas.editoraenterprising.net/index.php/rpcj/article/view/913>). [A Council of Ministers decree in force from April 2026 created the National Commission for Artificial Intelligence, the CNIA](<https://clubofmozambique.com/news/commission-begins-advising-government-on-the-use-of-artificial-intelligence-in-mozambique/>). [It advises the government on ethical, legal, security and social issues of AI, Lusa reported](<https://clubofmozambique.com/news/commission-begins-advising-government-on-the-use-of-artificial-intelligence-in-mozambique/>). Both dates are within the last twelve months. No rule on AI harms in force and no bill has been found. Preparing would need a bill, draft regulation or draft guideline addressing a harm from AI, or a draft that provides for an authority over AI.

In April 2024 the Director of Public Prosecutions' newsletter said the [Cybersecurity and Cybercrime Act 2021 makes it a crime to create and share obscene deepfakes with intent to harm](<https://lexpress.mu/node/534256>). [A September 2026 blog by Vishal Askurn says the Data Protection Act 2017 applies where AI systems process personal data](<https://defimedia.info/blog-artificial-intelligence-mauritius-progress-regulation-and-road-ahead>). On 29 October 2026 the ICT minister, Avinash Ramtohul, told the National Assembly that [draft amendments to the 2021 Act had been prepared](<https://lexpress.mu/node/564170>). They cover deepfakes and harmful AI-generated content, and provide for a Cybersecurity and Cybercrime Agency. Both 2026 dates are within the last twelve months. No source found says a body is designated with a mandate over AI. Operating would need a body designated by law or decree with a mandate over AI harms or AI systems.

In August 2026 the government said it was [drafting legislation to regulate the use of AI over its ethical risks](<https://www.telecompaper.com/news/malawi-drafts-ai-bill--1579445>). ICT minister Shadric Namalomba said the bill should be tabled in parliament before December 2026. In August 2026 the ICT ministry said [the AI Bill will establish a regulatory framework for AI](<https://itweb.africa/article/malawi-drafts-ai-bill-to-govern-public-sector-tech/PmxVE7KEOnpqQY85>). Both statements are within the last twelve months. No source found says a rule on harms from AI is in force, or that a body is designated with a mandate over AI. Establishing would need a law, decree, regulation or binding directive in force that addresses a harm from AI, such as deepfakes, automated decisions or AI in elections.

[In January 2026 the ICT minister said consultations on the draft Cybercrime Bill would resume in February](<https://www.channelafrica.co.za/channelafrica/news/namibia-moves-to-fast-track-cybercrime-data-protection-laws/>). [The bill targets image-based abuse and malicious use of deepfakes](<https://www.channelafrica.co.za/channelafrica/news/namibia-moves-to-fast-track-cybercrime-data-protection-laws/>). [In October 2025 the Presidency called a deepfake video of the president criminal under Namibian law](<https://www.namibian.com.na/presidency-sounds-alarm-on-fake-ai-video-of-nandi-ndaitwah/>). [It named no law](<https://www.namibian.com.na/presidency-sounds-alarm-on-fake-ai-video-of-nandi-ndaitwah/>). The January 2026 statement is within the last twelve months. No rule on AI harms in force has been found, and no body designated over AI. Establishing would need a law, decree, regulation or binding directive in force that addresses a harm from AI, such as deepfakes, automated decisions or AI in elections.

[In September 2025 jurist Abdou Malam Garba told Le Sahel that Niger has no AI-specific framework](<https://www.lesahel.org/lintelligence-artificielle-un-outil-benefique-avec-diverses-contraintes/>). [He said Law 2022-59 of 16 December 2022 on personal data applies to AI](<https://www.lesahel.org/lintelligence-artificielle-un-outil-benefique-avec-diverses-contraintes/>). [Under that law AI developers and service providers operating in Niger must declare to the data protection authority, the HAPDP](<https://www.lesahel.org/lintelligence-artificielle-un-outil-benefique-avec-diverses-contraintes/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found says a body is designated with a mandate over AI, or gives an enforcement or redress decision about a harm from AI. Operating would need a body designated by law or decree with a mandate over AI harms or AI systems.

[GAID Article 43, issued by the NDPC in 2025, applies to controllers deploying AI to process personal data](<https://theliberalist.org/nigeria-needs-no-ai-law-it-already-has-one/>).
